title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.22 - compatibility with game v0.110.0. Update to this if you have updated the game: on v0.110.0 the previous release fails to load at all, so the meter does not appear. That is fixed, and fights are recorded again. The reworked Outbreak is also handled. It is now a skill that poisons every enemy and triggers that poison on the spot, which is a route the meter did not watch - its damage was not merely unlabelled but missing from your totals entirely, and it is now credited to whoever applied the poison. Haze, Mirage and the renamed Sidestep were checked against the same paths and needed no change; runs you have already saved are unaffected. Still works on game v0.107.1 and later.
